source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.1, data build 995, released 2026-10-16

data.summary: Whenever this model's unit finishes a [Charge move](vsdata:core-rule/charge-move), every enemy unit in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of it takes a [Battle-shock test](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock).

effect.battleShockTest: each enemy unit within Engagement Range of that unit
